title: Base trigram axes and poles apply by default; every decision gets a trigram, and consistency builds the system (2026-10-28)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
So SRS programme should have put base trigram axes and poles affirmed?

These should apply by default and any decision can be mapped against them. This will give each decision a trigram. 

We can use the trigrams to see our basic stance. 

We can also apply the 4 elements to every domain. Although these can also be broken down into a 2x2 matrix. 

These synthetic maps never need to be absolute. They are always relative to a domain. And we may need to also refine judgement based on other decisions within a domain.

We can see from the compass that over time we can understand our stance in each cell, and we build a consistent system by being consistent
